notes.title: Work is in progress on episode 1.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
We have completed the structure and events of all 4 episodes.
We are writing the script for Episodes 1 and 2.
New characters have been introduced into the story, and their sprites are being developed.
Maps and item retrieval will appear.
There will be a lot of, like in the Prologue, animated backgrounds.
All in all, the Deep Lake universe is expanding.
By the way, here's one of the new backgrounds, revealing the secrets of the mysterious homestead.
